package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.Documented;
import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;

/**
 * Declares a managed logical asynchronous result, encoded as its payload rather than a future object.
 * Supported remote declarations are concrete {@code CompletionStage<T>} or {@code CompletableFuture<T>}.
 * The host must enable the calling policy and physical ownership adapter; unsupported shapes fail before entry.
 * Cancellation or timeout ends caller waiting, never proves physical exit or reverses an application effect.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.TYPE})
public @interface Async {
}

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;

/**
 * Declares application cooperation with the host invocation cancellation signal.
 * The signal is available through the current invocation control; this annotation grants no authority
 * and does not promise interruption, termination or undo. Capacity remains owned until physical exit.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.TYPE})
public @interface Cancellable {
}

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;

import java.lang.annotation.Target;

@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.METHOD)

     * @return operation filter
     */
    String filter() default "";
    /**
     * Declares the durable handler contract version; incompatible definitions require a new identity.
     * @return positive version
     */
    int version() default 1;
}

package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.*;

/**
 * Declares a typed managed factory method. The factory receiver and parameters are graph
 * dependencies. Owned returned AutoCloseable values are closed once by their owning scope;
 * borrowed values remain the caller's responsibility. Lifecycle hooks are a separate hosting API.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.METHOD)
public @interface Produces {
    /**
     * Product ownership, independent of the factory receiver's ownership.
     */
    enum Ownership {
        /**
         * The resolving managed scope disposes the returned value.
         */
        OWNED,
        /**
         * The application or host that supplied the value disposes it.
         */
        BORROWED
    }
    /**
     * Returns an exact optional product name; Named's existing targets remain unchanged.
     * @return the empty string for an unnamed product
     */
    String name() default "";
    /**
     * Returns who disposes the produced value.
     * @return managed ownership by default
     */
    Ownership ownership() default Ownership.OWNED;
}

    /**

     * @return policy identity
     */
    String policy() default "default";
    /**
     * Returns positive logical publication contract version.
     * @return contract version
     */
    int version() default 1;
}

package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.*;

/**
 * Selects a trusted host policy for native participating resource 2PC, not JDBC or external ACID.
 * REQUIRED joins only the same actual owned invocation/profile. Ordinary Java self-calls do not
 * introduce interception, and a remote hop does not convey transaction authority.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.METHOD)
public @interface ResourceTransaction {
    /**
     * Returns the exact trusted resource transaction policy name.
     * @return registered policy ID, defaulting to the explicit default registration
     */
    String policy() default "default";
}

/**
 * Selects a trusted durable trigger for a DurableJob entry; it is not a local JVM timer.
 * Host setup supplies time zone, DST, missed-fire, overlap and bounded catch-up policy. Pending
 * occurrences and stable submission identity survive restarts; metadata grants no clock authority.

public @interface Schedule {
    /**
     * Returns the exact installed durable trigger identity.
     * @return nonempty host-validated trigger name
     */
    String value();
}

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;

/**

 * Generated adapters require no reflective access. Constructors/accessors are trusted application code.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
public @interface SchemaType {
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return stable wire identifier, matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}
     */
    String id();
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return positive schema version; a registry accepts only adjacent versions
     */
    int version();
}

package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.*;

/**
 * Selects the lifetime of a managed component or produced value; no cluster singleton is implied.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.TYPE, ElementType.METHOD})
public @interface Scope {
    /**
     * Supported explicit ownership lifetimes.
     */
    enum Kind {
        /**
         * One instance per application container activation.
         */
        ACTIVATION,
        /**

         */

         */

    }

     * Returns the managed lifetime.

    Kind value() default Kind.ACTIVATION;
}

package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.*;

/**
 * Requests a stable binding to an explicitly versioned ordinary business interface.
 * The host must provide discovery, authorization and the named binding policy. Annotation presence
 * grants no authority. Refresh never implies retry or durable deduplication of an invocation.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.FIELD, ElementType.PARAMETER})
public @interface ServiceRef {
    /**
     * Returns the logical service name.
     * @return exact service name
     */
    String name();
    /**
     * Returns the public contract identity.
     * @return explicit identity, or empty to use the requested interface binary name
     */
    String contractId() default "";
    /**
     * Returns the required contract version.
     * @return positive version, default1
     */
    int contractVersion() default 1;
    /**
     * Returns the explicit refresh mode.
     * @return NEVER unless opted in
     */
    BindingRefresh refresh() default BindingRefresh.NEVER;
    /**
     * Returns a host-owned binding policy identifier.
     * @return default policy name
     */
    String policy() default "default";
}

}

package org.j7m.middleware.annotations;

import java.lang.annotation.Documented;
import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;

/**
 * Defines a stable numeric wire identity independent of the Java record component name.
 * Every schema component must declare this annotation. Primitive components must be required.
 * Optional scalar defaults are parsed and validated at compilation; absent defaults mean null.
 */
@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT)
public @interface WireField {
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return positive wire ID, represented as canonical decimal by the D00 codec
     */
    int id();
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return whether null or absent values are rejected
     */
    boolean required() default true;
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return whether defaultValue is explicitly provided; required fields cannot have defaults
     */
    boolean hasDefault() default false;
    /**
     * Returns the declared contract value.
     * @return scalar default text; byte arrays and nested schemas cannot have non-null defaults
     */
    String defaultValue() default "";
}
